releaseNotes: v1.0.11: Added full support for modern ART Service compilation flags on Android 14+ (Galaxy S24 Ultra, modern One UI, Pixel). Runs with --full to compile primary dex, secondary dex, dynamic split APKs, and dependency trees in one shot, plus -p PRIORITY_INTERACTIVE_FAST for top-tier CPU core scheduling, with seamless fallback for older Android devices.
